The test image shows a single large, fusiform (cigar/spindle-shaped), brown/tan lesion on a corn leaf — this is the hallmark of **Northern Corn Leaf Blight**. The NCLB reference top-left panel is nearly identical to the test image: same shape, same color, same size, same orientation parallel to leaf veins.
